title: Framework Configuration
description: Schema for framework.yaml — the machine-readable companion to framework.md. The file itself ships with action-plan item P1 (issue #63); this schema is forward-looking so editor plugins and adopters can prepare. Per round-5 §7 of the engagement, additionalProperties is false at the top level: the validator rejects unknown sections deterministically.

contract_version.description: Per A5: equals the framework version. Single version number; no dual-version drift.

compliance_target.description: The compliance tier this adopter targets, per docs/adopt/compliance-profile.md. The current AGF v2 Rust agov framework-config validator validates the declared value.

precedence.description: Ordered conflict-resolution layers. Conventional ordering: rules > agents > learnings (top-most wins).

binding.description: Layer 3 binding-contract configuration. Binding validation is deferred in current AGF v2 tooling; see docs/binding-contract.md.

patterns.description: Branch glob patterns where Agent-ID: trailers are required. Default fallback: agent/*.

validators.description: Per-validator overrides (e.g. opting out of advisory checks). Free-form pending P1 design.
